notes.title: Avenir Update (1.1.0.0)
notes.content:
Hello,

The Tower has been updated, hopefully I didn't forget the .exe.

NEW
[list]
[*] Sprint with SHIFT
[*] Part of some levels have been modified to improve experience.
[*] Glowing keys and teleporters - Falling isn't the end.
[*] Ladders have been added.
[*] Sound levels have been adjusted - more of that later.
[/list]
Hopefully I haven't forgotten to put in the .exe
[i]La bise ~
Avenir Dev[/i]
